messages:
Tess: opened PR to tighten SOC2 wording in the export docs and add a short client-side pseudonymization example. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1582

Ian: quick scan - looks good. tiny nit: use the phrase 'pseudonymized identifiers' not 'masked' so SOC2 reviewers see the right terminology.

Legal: Agreed. Also add a one-line sentence clarifying control boundary: 'Customers control salts/keys used for pseudonymization; Redwood does not retain them by default.'

Sam: On the code sample, prefer HMAC examples (py/js). I'll flag that we must keep KMS calls as placeholders and not imply managed keys.

Tess: updated wording and swapped in HMAC snippets; kept KMS pseudocode comments. Also fixed a broken internal anchor to #data-residency-and-sovereignty. Pushed changes.

docs-bot: CI: docs build passed on staging  linkcheck OK, code-sample-check OK.

Ian: :thumbsup: I added a changelog line under docs/changelog.md -> Security: clarify export pseudonymization wording and add HMAC client examples.

Tess: Thanks everyone  merging in 5 unless objections.
